source.check: Irish News, 4 June 1949, p. 3: 'David Beattie (Unionist), 104; Patrick M'Namee (A.P.), 88. Unionist majority, 16' (the OCR reads M'Namec); also Ulster Herald, 11 June 1949, p. 3

note: Triennial election of the 28 electoral divisions of Strabane rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Nominations were received on Tuesday 17 May 1949 by Mr. W. S. Moody, clerk; 19 Unionists and 7 Anti-Partitionists were returned unopposed and two divisions were contested, Newtownstewart and Douglas Bridge (Strabane Chronicle, 21 May 1949, p. 1, which lists every nomination). Labels are as printed in that list.
